summary: Comprehensive FileShare Portal testing completed with German interface. Backend APIs working correctly, frontend showing all required features including logo, admin login, FileShare with storage tabs, folder creation, and share permissions system.

integration_issues.issue: User sessions expire quickly during testing, requiring frequent re-authentication

passed_tests: Logo displays on login page (EVENTENERGIE DEUTSCHLAND)
Hub page shows FileShare and Benutzerverwaltung options
FileShare page loads with 'Mein Bereich' and 'Gemeinsamer Bereich' tabs
Folder creation functionality works in personal area
Share modal opens with Download, Upload, and Edit permission toggles
Admin panel (Benutzerverwaltung) shows users table with FileShare permissions
Backend API endpoints all working (18/18 tests passed)
User management with FileShare app permissions functional
Folder sharing with permission controls (Download, Upload, Edit) working
Share link creation with expiration and password protection working
Admin can view all users and their file/folder statistics

success_percentage.frontend: 95% (all major features working, minor session timeout issue)
